product.title: Calm. Cum să-ți găsești liniștea într-o lume stresantă și agitată
product.description: Icirc;ntr-o lume saturată de tehnologie și supusă unor transformări rapide, in care ne confruntăm in permanență cu prea multe alegeri de făcut și cu sarcini multiple de realizat, calmul de care avem cu disperare nevoie pare tot mai greu de atins. Strămoșii noștri foloseau mecanismul luptă-sau-fugi pentru a se proteja de prădători; astăzi, noi il folosim zilnic ca să facem față situațiilor de criză. Rezultatul este stresul cronic și incapacitatea de a fi calmi, ceea ce ne impiedică să funcționăm la intreaga noastră capacitate. Autoarea ne arată, in această carte documentată științific, cum să ne folosim de puterea sistemului nostru natural de relaxare pentru a scăpa de migrene, dureri de gacirc;t, probleme gastrointestinale, tulburări de somn sau chiar pentru a face mai bine față dificultăților vieții. Nu avem nevoie de medicamente, ci doar de cacirc;teva tehnici ușor de pus in practică și care vor sparge cercul vicios al stresului. Rețeta eficientă pentru o viață mai fericită! Dr. Gayatri Devi este neurolog, directorul New York Memory Services și profesor asociat la Școala de Medicină a Universității din New York. A colaborat, printre alții, cu BBC, CBS, The Wall Street Journal și Time. Este președinta Asociaţiei Femeilor Medic Americane.

# Calm: Finding Peace in a Stressful and Agitated World

Discover proven, science-backed methods to manage chronic stress and reclaim your inner calm with this essential guide. Published by Litera, this book offers practical techniques to navigate the demands of modern life and find lasting tranquility.

## Reclaiming Your Calm in a Chaotic World

In our fast-paced, technology-saturated world, we constantly face numerous choices and multiple tasks, often leading us to rely on survival mechanisms like the fight-or-flight response. This constant state of alertness results in chronic stress and an inability to function at our full capacity.

This book addresses this reality head-on, guiding you through the natural relaxation systems within your body to effectively manage the pressures of daily life. It provides a roadmap for shifting from a reactive, stressed state to one of balanced well-being.

## The Science of Stress Relief

Instead of relying on medication, this guide introduces simple, actionable techniques rooted in neuroscience. Learn how you can harness your body's natural relaxation mechanisms to alleviate common physical and mental ailments caused by stress.

Inside, you will discover strategies designed to help you manage:
*   Migraines and headaches
*   Gastrointestinal problems
*   Sleep disturbances
*   General life difficulties

## Expert Guidance for Lasting Peace

This book is authored by Dr. Gayatri Devi, a highly respected neurologist, director of the New York Memory Services, and a professor at the University of New York Medical School. Dr. Deviâs expertise is grounded in extensive collaboration with organizations like BBC, CBS, The Wall Street Journal, and Time, lending significant credibility to the methods presented.

She demonstrates how simple techniques can effectively break the vicious cycle of stress and lead to a happier, more balanced life for everyone.

## Start Your Journey to Well-being Today

Ready to transform how you handle stress? Unlock the recipe for a more joyful life by incorporating these practical tools into your daily routine.

**Get your copy of *Calm: How to Find Peace in a Stressful and Agitated World* today!**

**Q: Is this book based on medical science?**
A: Yes, the strategies presented in this book are documented scientifically and focus on utilizing the body's natural relaxation systems to manage stress.

**Q: Does this book require medication?**
A: No. The book focuses on providing practical, easy-to-implement techniques that help you manage stress without needing medication.

**Q: Who is the author?**
A: The book is written by Dr. Gayatri Devi, a neurologist and highly recognized expert in stress management.
